Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.

swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: MC33202DR2G is limited to 12 V max (13 V abs max, p.3) whereas OPA2134UA supports up to 36 V (36 V abs max, p.5). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (MC33202DR2G: IN=RR, OUT=RR vs OPA2134UA: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 3.6x (MC33202DR2G: 2.2 MHz p.4 vs OPA2134UA: 8 MHz p.7); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 20x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs OPA2134UA: 20 V/µs p.7); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 16000x (MC33202DR2G: 80000 pA p.3 vs OPA2134UA: 5 pA p.7); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 4.4x (MC33202DR2G: 900 µA/ch p.4 vs OPA2134UA: 4000 µA/ch p.8); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: MC33202DR2G has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (13 V, p.3) than OPA2134UA (36 V, p.5); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 13 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: OPA2134UA requires Vs,min >= 5 V (p.5) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (MC33202DR2G: -40..105 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 105°C) vs OPA2134UA: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C)); OPA2134UA hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and OPA2134UA (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; GBWP differs 3.6x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 2.2 MHz (p.4) vs 8 MHz (p.7), supply ceiling 12 V (p.1) vs 36 V (p.5), Vos 8 mV (p.3) vs 3.5 mV (p.7), Ib 16000x gap (80000 vs 5 pA), voltage noise 20 vs 8 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: MC33202DR2G "Internal Back-to-Back Differential Input Clamp Diodes Limit Comparator Use" (p.3) and OPA2134UA "High 4 mA/ch Quiescent Current Causes 38°C–48°C Self-Heating in SOIC-8 at ±15 V" (p.8). BOM decision: Choose MC33202DR2G when single-supply ADC headroom demands full Rail-to-Rail I/O swing or ultra-low supply current (900 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose OPA2134UA when supply rails exceed 12 V (rated up to 36 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 8 MHz GBWP. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
